defective_pattern: Passing raw Markdown asterisks ('*', '**') directly into '<w:t>' nodes without parsing them into native Word runs.
why_defective: Leaves literal Markdown characters inside final Word documents, rendering them unprofessional.
observed_symptoms: Asterisks around text in DOCX output (e.g., '*N*', '*p*').
Lack of proper italic/bold formatting in Word output.
corrective_remedy: Implement inline Markdown tokenization parsing italic ('*...*') and bold ('**...**') into distinct OpenXML runs with '<w:i/>' or '<w:b/>'.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Presence of literal '*' characters used for emphasis inside '<w:t>' elements of generated DOCX files.
